se toþ se þanne bistandeþ IIII scill';
se ðe ðonne bi ðam standeþ III scill';

Æt þam feower toðum fyrestum, æt gehwylcum VI scillingas.
Se toþ se þanne bi standeþ, IIII sciƚƚ.
Se þe ðonne bi ðam standeþ, III sciƚƚ.
And þonne siþþan gehwylc, scilling.
Bei den vier vordersten Zähnen, bei allen [kostet das Ausschlagen] je 6 Schillinge;
der Zahn, welcher dann [je] daneben steht, 4 Schill.;
der, welcher dann [je] neben letzteren steht, 3 Schill.,
und dann dahinter jeder [1] Schilling.
For the four front teeth, for all of them [knocking one out costs] 6 shillings each;
the tooth which then stands next to [each of] them, 4 shillings;
the one which then stands next to [each of] the latter, 3 shillings,
and then each one behind that, [1] shilling.
For each of the 4 front teeth, 6 shillings [shall be paid as compensation];
for each of the teeth which stand next to these, 4 shillings [shall be paid as compensation];
then for each tooth which stands next to them, 3 shillings [shall be paid as compensation];
and beyond that 1 shilling [shall be paid as compensation] for each tooth.
For the foremost four teeth, for each 6 shillings.
[For] that [tooth] which is beside there, 4 shillings.
[For] that [tooth] which is beside that one, 3 shillings.
And [for] each of the others, a shilling.
